data.gender_notes: Nabihi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is submissive and obedient to Allah. In Islamic tradition, a Nabih is a respected and pious figure, often a guide or teacher. The name Nabihi carries the meaning “Servant, Worshiper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabihi usually hope their child will grow to embody servant, worshiper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to always prioritize Allah in our lives and actions.
data.etymology: Nabihi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant, Worshiper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabihi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nabihi holds great respect in Islamic culture, as it is the name given to those who strive to live a pious and obedient life to Allah. Nabihis are held in high esteem within society and often serve as spiritual leaders and guides for others. They are revered for their dedication to their faith, their wisdom, and their abilities as teachers and helpers.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nabihi holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims, as it represents a conscious effort to live a life of submission and obedience to Allah. It is a reminder of the importance of following the teachings of the Quran, striving for spiritual growth, and seeking knowledge and wisdom. By bearing this name, individuals are inspired to aspire to these virtues and to be a positive influence on those around them.
